name: action-range-inventory-chunk576
auditSeams: `DoCheckSightOrRange`/`P_CheckSight` in player loops, `DropInventory`, `CreateThinker`, explode/damage/state jumps, `Spawn`, boss/unblock/destroy.
auditRationale: Squared range, inventory/blend guards, countdown bounds, and burst PR/velocity formulas are ported; engine calls are seams.
auditPaddingReview:
**Fidelity review (2026-10-21):** `BurstShardVelocityZ` is the faithful `mo->Vel.Z = 4 * (mo->Z() - self->Z()) / self->Height` at `A_Burst` **2105** (not a ratio-only helper). Excluded `Spawn`/`Destroy`/`A_BossDeath` (`2101`, `2114–2121`), `P_ExplodeMissile`/`P_DamageMobj`/`SetState` (`2050–2061`), `CreateThinker` (`2028–2030`).
